checks.details: The exact installed template-free recognizer accepted one strict Home bubble for gold, elixir, and dark elixir from fresh live captures, with Home re-proven before every accepted click.
A fresh post-run Home capture showed all three resource bubbles absent while all three resource totals increased and the gem balance remained unchanged.

notes: Redacted live recognition evidence for the exact template-free collectors route. Raw frames were intentionally not retained because they contained player and clan identifiers; this does not establish Loot Cart, Treasury, Daily Reward, donation, upgrade, or other Home maintenance recognition.
